liquidity_reconciliation.no_aggregation_rule: Do not sum, average or compare these values as if they were synchronized spot liquidity. Preserve product, venue universe, timestamp and price band.

prior_fix_activation.provenance_note: The activation timestamp and ledger index are preserved from the earlier exact EnableAmendment ledger reconstruction in the XRP research archive; the later dashboard snapshot is a separate post-activation voting view.

governance_method.official_rule: An amendment must maintain more than 80% support from trusted validators for two weeks. Support falling to 80% or less restarts the period.
governance_method.official_enablement_evidence: An EnableAmendment pseudo-transaction with no flags indicates the amendment is enabled.
governance_method.secondary_denominator_disagreement: XRPL Dashboard reported 35 of 35 validators heard; XRPL.to described 36 trusted validators. The required yes count was 29 in both extracts. Retain the differing denominator scopes.

xrpl_amendment_state.interpretation: The fixCleanup3_4_0 bug-fix amendment was enabled, but SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocol remained below the 29-vote threshold in the Nov 4 15:27 UTC snapshot. A protocol bug fix is not a lending launch, XRP collateral utilization, loan origination or proof of new XRP demand.

observations.claim: TradRadar displayed approximately $2.04B XRP perpetual open interest, +1.26% over 24 hours, +0.0086% OI-weighted funding per eight hours, at least $8.05M of liquidations, and a 3.20 long/short account ratio with 76.2% long accounts.

The account ratio is long-skewed, but funding is positive rather than extreme in this snapshot and long/short liquidations are close to balanced. These facts are compatible with crowded longs, but do not prove imminent liquidation or a directional price move.

CoinGecko's Sep 30 eight-CEX spot-depth study and Basis's Nov 4 07:18 UTC single-Binance-perpetual heatmap differ in date, venue coverage, instrument and price-band definitions. They cannot be combined into one XRP spot-liquidity estimate.

The prior ledger reconstruction records fixCleanup3_4_0 enabled at ledger 108112129, while the later Nov 4 15:27 UTC dashboard snapshot shows SingleAssetVault at 21/35 and LendingProtocol at 19/35, both below 29 required. This does not establish that XRPL lending is live or that XRP is being used as collateral.

source_independence_and_disagreement: TradRadar is one multi-exchange aggregator; its seven venue inputs are not seven independent aggregators.
Basis is a third-party visualization of Binance's perpetual order book; the underlying venue overlaps the derivatives ecosystem and its snapshot is 14 hours older than TradRadar's displayed update.
CoinGecko's study is an older eight-CEX spot-depth benchmark and is not a live source.

XRPL Dashboard and XRPL.to are separate rendered views of the same public ledger/governance process; they are not independent validator networks. Their denominator descriptions differ (35 heard versus 36 trusted) and are retained separately.
XRPL.org documentation defines the protocol rule but does not provide the current live vote tally.
No provider values were averaged, and no cross-venue executable spread or arbitrage claim is made.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The long-skewed account ratio and rising reported OI may increase sensitivity to a downside liquidation cascade.
support: TradRadar reports 76.2% long accounts, 3.20 account ratio and +1.26% OI change.
disconfirming_or_missing: Funding is +0.0086% per eight hours, not an extreme reading by itself.
Long and short liquidation values are nearly balanced.
No raw account-level positions, top-trader notional, liquidation clusters or synchronized spot flow are captured.
tests: Capture native per-exchange OI/funding and liquidation streams at one timestamp; compare account and notional ratios; test whether spot depth absorbs forced flow.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XRP may have substantial aggregate spot liquidity while individual venues or perpetual books show materially different near-touch depth.
support: CoinGecko reports broad eight-CEX spot depth; Basis reports a single-venue perpetual snapshot.
disconfirming_or_missing: The observations are not synchronized and use different instruments, price bands and methods.
tests: Capture full raw spot and perpetual books on the same venues and timestamp, preserve sequence IDs and normalize depth by common price bands.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The successful fixCleanup3_4_0 activation may be mistaken for the launch of XRPL native lending, although the required lending amendments remained below threshold in the later snapshot.
support: The post-activation dashboard snapshot shows LendingProtocol 19/35 and SingleAssetVault 21/35 against 29 required.
disconfirming_or_missing: A later validator snapshot could change; no post-Nov-4 Nov-5 vote snapshot was captured.
tests: Read the current Amendments ledger entry and trusted-validator votes directly; verify every prerequisite amendment and the activation pseudo-transaction before classifying lending as live.

data_quality_controls.raw_receipt_coverage: None of the rendered page extracts in this artifact has a byte-complete raw payload or SHA-256 receipt.
data_quality_controls.timestamp_policy: Preserve each provider's displayed event/update time separately from the research retrieval time. Do not infer synchronization from a common calendar date.
data_quality_controls.instrument_policy: Do not treat perpetual mark price or perpetual order-book depth as spot price or spot depth.
data_quality_controls.capital_policy: Open interest is contract exposure, not net capital inflow. Account ratios are not notional ratios. Liquidation totals are provider-reported and may be lower bounds.
data_quality_controls.protocol_policy: Do not infer a feature launch, collateral utilization or XRP demand from an amendment bug fix or sub-threshold vote count.
